description: Source code implementing file descriptor BIO methods for OpenSSL, including functions for reading, writing, and controlling file descriptor BIOs.

methods.name: bio_fd_non_fatal_error
methods.description: Checks if an error code is a non-fatal error for file descriptor I/O.

methods.name: bio_fd_should_retry
methods.description: Determines if an I/O operation should be retried based on the return value.

methods.name: BIO_new_fd
methods.description: Creates a new BIO object for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: fd_new
methods.description: Initializes a BIO object for file descriptor use.

methods.name: fd_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a BIO object.

methods.name: fd_read
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor BIO.

methods.name: fd_write
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor BIO.

methods.name: fd_ctrl
methods.description: Performs control operations on a file descriptor BIO.

methods.name: fd_gets
methods.description: Reads a line from a file descriptor BIO.
